name: Bubble UI
description: Soap film interface components: buttons, icon buttons, a search field, a menu, switches and sliders that refract and mirror what is behind them like liquid glass, with swirling thin-film colors you can tune from bubble to glass.

controls.name: radius
controls.label: Corner radius (px)
controls.description: Corner radius of the shape, in pixels at a 16 px font; it grows with the text. Large values give fully round ends. The film bulges in as far as this radius, so panels get a soft pillow edge and circles stay spheres.

controls.name: bevel
controls.label: Glass bevel (px)
controls.description: Width of the refracting edge as Liquid glass rises, in pixels at a 16 px font. It grows with the component's text so larger controls keep their proportions.

controls.name: iridescence
controls.label: Oil film
controls.description: Strength of the oily interference colors. At 0 the film reflects without color, 1 is physical soap film and higher values saturate the bands.

controls.name: filmScale
controls.label: Oil size
controls.description: Size of the oil's color bands and swirls. Larger values give broad, calm bands; smaller values break the film into fine, busy patches.

controls.name: oilOpacity
controls.label: Oil opacity
controls.description: Opacity of the iridescent oil, independent of Tint opacity. At 0 the oil colors disappear; at 1 the spectral bands stay visible even over an opaque Tint. Oil coverage and Clear centre still define where the oil appears.

controls.name: oilCoverage
controls.label: Oil coverage
controls.description: How much of the film shows oil colors. At 1 the whole film is iridescent; lower values leave clear film between oil slicks, whose size follows Oil size.

controls.name: oilEdge
controls.label: Oil edge (px)
controls.description: On large components such as panels, bars and menus, how far in from the rim the oil reaches, in pixels at a 16 px font. Their middle stays clear; small buttons keep oil all over. 0 shows oil everywhere.

controls.name: oilEdgeFade
controls.label: Oil edge fade
controls.description: How strongly large components clear the oil from their middle. At 0 nothing fades, at 1 the middle is clear glass, and above 1 the oil band along the rim narrows too: 2 is half as wide, 3 a third.

controls.name: clearCenter
controls.label: Clear centre
controls.description: Clear oil and reflected haze from the centre of every component, including small buttons, switches and sliders. At 1 the middle is transparent while the rim keeps its oil colours; at 0 the material is unchanged. Works even with Oil edge at 0 and scales with the component.

controls.name: tint
controls.label: Tint
controls.description: Base color of the whole material. Also colors the soap film, darker shades and highlights while their colors are Auto. Opacity sets the strength; transparent restores the untinted look.

controls.name: soapColor
controls.label: Soap color
controls.description: A gentle color filter for the soap's full multicolor spectrum, including its oily rim. Auto follows Tint; a custom color changes the filter. Opacity sets its strength while retaining the natural rainbow bands; transparent leaves their colors unchanged.

controls.name: soapPalette
controls.label: Soap palette
controls.description: Original iridescence keeps the natural multicolor soap spectrum. Color presets load their own six-color spectra into Custom colors, where each hue family stays editable while the same bands and swirls keep moving.

controls.name: soapPaletteRed
controls.label: Soap reds
controls.description: Custom color for the red and pink bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapPaletteGold
controls.label: Soap golds
controls.description: Custom color for the yellow and gold bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapPaletteGreen
controls.label: Soap greens
controls.description: Custom color for the green bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapPaletteCyan
controls.label: Soap cyans
controls.description: Custom color for the cyan and turquoise bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapPaletteBlue
controls.label: Soap blues
controls.description: Custom color for the blue bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapPaletteViolet
controls.label: Soap violets
controls.description: Custom color for the violet and purple bands. Opacity blends it with the original spectral colors. Used only with Custom colors.

controls.name: soapShadeColor
controls.label: Soap shades
controls.description: Color of the darker parts of the film, the inner reflection and the bottom shade when enabled. Auto follows Tint; set a separate color and opacity to customize the shading.

controls.name: soapHighlightColor
controls.label: Soap highlights
controls.description: Color of the reflected light, bright bevel and window highlights. Auto follows Tint; a separate color and opacity lets the lights contrast with the soap. Transparent preserves the original lighting colors.

controls.name: thickness
controls.label: Film thickness (nm)
controls.description: Mean thickness of the film. Thin films show golds and magentas, near 0 they turn black, and thick films wash out to pale pinks and greens.

controls.name: drainage
controls.label: Drainage
controls.description: How far gravity has pulled water to the bottom: a thin cap with horizontal bands over a thicker base.

controls.name: swirl
controls.label: Swirl
controls.description: Marangoni flow that stirs the film into drifting eddies.

controls.name: reflectivity
controls.label: Reflectivity
controls.description: Brightness of everything the film reflects. 1 is soapy water; real bubbles are faint, so the default lifts them slightly.

controls.name: mirage
controls.label: Mirage
controls.description: Reflections of the objects around the bubble, wrapped around its rim. Needs a backdrop.

controls.name: reach
controls.label: Mirage reach
controls.description: How far around the bubble the mirrored objects come from, in bubble radii.

controls.name: refraction
controls.label: Refraction
controls.description: Bends the light passing through the bubble like liquid glass. A real film is 0; at 1 the bubble behaves as a ball of water. Needs a backdrop.

controls.name: glass
controls.label: Liquid glass
controls.description: Morphs the soap film into liquid glass. At 0 it is a blown bubble; towards 1 the face flattens, the curvature gathers into a refracting bevel, the film turns into solid glass and the rim catches light. Oil film still tints the glass.

controls.name: dispersion
controls.label: Dispersion
controls.description: Separation of colors in the light bent by the glass bevel. Takes effect as Liquid glass rises.

controls.name: environment
controls.label: Lighting
controls.description: The room the bubbles reflect: dark studio softboxes, a bright window, open sky, soft light for light interfaces, or auto, which picks soft on light pages and studio on dark ones.

controls.name: tilt
controls.label: Pointer parallax
controls.description: How far the reflections slide as the pointer moves over the bubble.

controls.name: windowLight
controls.label: Window light
controls.description: Adds the window of the intro bubbles: a thick band with round ends that follows the top-left edge of each shape, and a small spark past its end. It slides as the pointer turns the room and rides the wobble.

controls.name: windowStyle
controls.label: Window style
controls.description: Edge runs along each control's top-left edge and on along the top. Bubble is the window as it first was, the intro's bean and round glint, bent to follow each control's real curve.

controls.name: windowLength
controls.label: Window length
controls.description: How far the window runs along the edge or round its arc. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowMargin
controls.label: Window margin
controls.description: How far in from the edge the window sits. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowBend
controls.label: Window bend
controls.description: On long controls, how closely the edge window follows the curve: 0 runs straight, 1 hugs the edge. Round buttons always keep their arc.

controls.name: windowWidth
controls.label: Window width
controls.description: Thickness of the window band alone, without changing its glint. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowHead
controls.label: Window head
controls.description: Thickness of the window's thick left end against the rest of the band, without moving it. 1 is as drawn; lower is a slimmer head.

controls.name: windowTail
controls.label: Window tail
controls.description: Thickness of the window's far end: low values draw it to a point, high ones keep it blunt. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: glintShape
controls.label: Glint shape
controls.description: The small glint past the window. Auto varies it per bubble on the edge style and keeps the original dot on the bubble style.

controls.name: glintSize
controls.label: Glint size
controls.description: Size of the glint. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: glintIntensity
controls.label: Glint intensity
controls.description: Brightness of the glint. 1 is as drawn; 0 hides it.

controls.name: glintDistance
controls.label: Glint distance
controls.description: How far past the window the glint sits. 0 is as drawn.

controls.name: glintHeight
controls.label: Glint height
controls.description: Moves the glint in towards the middle (positive) or out towards the rim (negative). 0 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowSize
controls.label: Window size
controls.description: How thick the window light and its glint are. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowIntensity
controls.label: Window intensity
controls.description: How bright the window light and its inner reflection are. 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowGradient
controls.label: Window gradient
controls.description: How much the window fades towards its right end. 0 keeps it even along its length; 1 fades it out by its tip. 0.24 is as drawn.

controls.name: windowTwin
controls.label: Inner reflection
controls.description: The window's faint, inverted twin on the far wall at the bottom right, seen through the film. Turn it off to keep only the window at the top.

controls.name: windowTwinShape
controls.label: Inner reflection shape
controls.description: Mirror turns both highlights at the top (the window and the long highlight along the top edge) round onto the bottom right, fainter; arc mirrors the window blurred; crescent is a thin line near the rim; streak a short straight one; dot a soft glint.

controls.name: keyLight
controls.label: Key reflection
controls.description: The reflection of the room's key light (the bright window, the studio softbox or the sun) at the top left. Turn it off to keep only the window light.

controls.name: topLength
controls.label: Top highlight length
controls.description: How far the highlight along the top edge, behind the window, runs. 1 is as drawn; lower is shorter, higher longer.

controls.name: topFade
controls.label: Top highlight fade
controls.description: How long the light panel overhead lets its highlight along a top edge fade out. 0 ends it crisply; higher values draw it out further and more gently.

controls.name: topTail
controls.label: Top highlight tail
controls.description: How the far end of the highlight along the top edge, behind the window, thins to a point (below 1) or stays blunt (above 1). 1 is as drawn.

controls.name: bottomShade
controls.label: Bottom shade
controls.description: Adds a soft band along the whole bottom inside, where the far wall catches the light. It follows the theme: a shadow on light pages, a glow on dark ones.

controls.name: bottomShadeColor
controls.label: Shade colour
controls.description: Colour of the bottom shade. Auto follows the theme (a shadow on light pages, a glow on dark ones); any other colour tints the band, and its opacity sets how strong it is.

controls.name: wobble
controls.label: Jiggle
controls.description: How much everything jiggles: the film on hover and press, the swell of a pressed button, the bounce of the opening menu and of the switch thumb. 0 holds them all still.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Rate of the film flow and the drifting inner bubbles.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Seed
controls.description: Chooses a different film pattern and inner bubble arrangement.

controls.name: paused
controls.label: Paused
controls.description: Hold the current frame. Pointer wobble still plays.
